title: Calendar month view layout tweaks (indicator positioning + wider month grid)

requirements.summary: Move the month-view availability dot indicator to the bottom of each day cell while preserving existing tints and today highlight styling.
acceptanceCriteria: On the month view (CalendarMonthPage), for dates with availability, the indicator renders at the bottom of the day cell (not in the top row next to the numeric date).
The numeric date label remains clearly readable and is not overlapped by the indicator across common viewport sizes.
Existing visual behaviors remain intact: background tint for days with availability and the 'today' border highlight still work as before.

file_operations.description: Update DayCell layout so the date number remains in the top area and the availability indicator dot is rendered in a dedicated bottom area (e.g., bottom-aligned row/slot) within the day cell, ensuring the dot no longer sits next to the date number while keeping existing conditional styles for availability tint and today border.

requirements.summary: Increase the effective width of the month grid so day numbers are not clipped, using horizontal overflow/scrolling on small screens instead of clipping.
acceptanceCriteria: In the month view, day numbers are not clipped/cut off at typical narrow and mid-size viewports.
The calendar and the grid have increased effective width (component and grid), without breaking the 7-column layout.
No horizontal clipping occurs inside the card content; if horizontal overflow is necessary on very small screens, the user can access all columns without content being cut off.

file_operations.description: Adjust the month grid container to avoid clipping by increasing effective grid width (e.g., applying a minimum width to the 7-column grid) and enabling horizontal scrolling in the CardContent region on very small screens (overflow-x behavior), so all 7 columns remain accessible without cutting off numeric labels.
